steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The Classical period prioritised clarity, balance and elegance — homophonic texture dominates, with clear melody above chordal accompaniment. | Key Fact: Sonata form became the primary structure for first movements: exposition (two contrasting themes in different keys), development, recapitulation. | Key Fact: The Classical orchestra standardised: strings formed the core, with woodwind (flute, oboe, clarinet, bassoon), horns, trumpets and timpani added. | Key Fact: Alberti bass is a broken-chord accompaniment pattern (low-high-middle-high) typical of Classical keyboard music — it provides harmonic and rhythmic support.
